looks.title: Mantra performance: compact base and performance outer layers
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a fitted full-length top, shorts or straight trousers, and one boxy jacket; keep coverage at the user's level.

looks.title: Brown suede jacket, flannel and pale sheer maxi
looks.alt: Jennie at the airport in an oversized brown suede jacket, checked shirt, pale sheer maxi layer and dark boots.
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Keep the sheer maxi, checked layer, boxy suede jacket and sturdy boots at full intensity when desired; add an opaque slip only as an optional coverage variant.

looks.title: Tour-day oversized jacket and beanie
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Make one well-shaped roomy jacket and a beanie the focus over a quiet base.

looks.title: ExtraL white suit with burgundy inner layer
looks.alt: Jennie and Doechii in crisp white relaxed suits with burgundy inner layers and gold accessories in the ExtraL video.
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a burgundy bra, sheer camisole or fitted top inside a relaxed white suit with genuinely low-slung trousers and a gold waist chain; change the rise only when requested.

looks.title: Like Jennie silver sculptural top with cargos
looks.alt: Jennie in the like JENNIE video wearing a metallic playful top, neutral relaxed cargo trousers, a decorated cap and long braids in an industrial dance scene.
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Pair a metallic or hardware-detail fitted top with relaxed cargos; replace the sculptural cup with a wearable metallic knit or vest.

looks.title: Love Hangover Chanel tweed and tailored micro shorts
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a tweed jacket with tailored shorts of comfortable length or a straight mini over tights; repeat one small bow detail only.

looks.title: Hoodie, mini dress and baggy jeans live layering
silhouette: short dress layer over wide long trouser
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Layer a short tunic or slip over relaxed jeans and keep hoodie or cap—not both—as the main casual signal.

looks.title: Coachella week one red western-ballet mix
looks.alt: Jennie performing at Coachella in a vivid red western-glam cropped jacket, compact stage base, cowboy hat and tall suede boots.
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a red accent jacket, fitted top, covered shorts or skirt, and western boot; translate lace as a small overlay rather than a costume tutu.

looks.title: Coachella week two black moto wardrobe
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Build a black base with one red lower or inner accent and a cropped moto jacket; omit extra themed accessories for daily wear.

looks.title: Crochet sweater vest with grey sweats and toe shoes
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Pair a crochet vest with clean grey joggers and choose either a cap or unusual sneaker as the focus.

looks.title: Graphic tee, low-slung trousers and ballet sneakers
looks.alt: Jennie in New York wearing a white graphic T-shirt, relaxed low-slung black trousers, silver sunglasses and black-and-white ballet sneakers.
stylingDevices: basic uniform plus one unexpected shoe
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Keep the relaxed trousers genuinely low-slung, meet them with a simple graphic tee, and use one hybrid or sleek sneaker plus silver eyewear.

looks.title: Chanel couture baby-blue cape with black trousers
looks.alt: Jennie at Chanel couture in a baby-blue feathered cape and matching sheer top with straight black trousers and a fine waist chain.
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Wear a pale-blue textured cardigan or cape over an opaque fitted top and straight black trousers; keep one bow or fine belt.

looks.title: Met Gala black satin jumpsuit and white-lined overskirt
looks.alt: Jennie at the 2025 Met Gala in a black-and-white tailored Chanel jumpsuit with dramatic overskirt, pearls, camellia and two-tone hat.
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a clean black column or jumpsuit, one white-edged layer, and either pearls or a small hat-inspired hair detail.

looks.title: Tamburins sculptural all-black peplum and skirt
looks.alt: Jennie at a Tamburins event in a buttoned black peplum coat, sculptural ruffled black skirt, tights and satin bow heels while holding one rose.
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Combine a shaped black jacket, simple black skirt or trousers, opaque tights, and one satin or floral detail.

looks.title: Vintage Chanel lingerie with open denim and moto layer
looks.alt: Jennie backstage on tour in vintage white Chanel lingerie, relaxed blue jeans, a cropped black moto jacket, layered pearls, gloves and lug boots.
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Preserve the lingerie, open relaxed denim, cropped moto jacket, pearls, gloves and boots for a same-intensity version; close the denim or swap the inner layer only when the user wants another exposure level.

looks.title: Lace bodysuit, brown baggy trousers and nylon shrug
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use the plunging lace bodysuit directly with low-slung relaxed brown trousers, slouchy boots, a green technical layer and chain detail when that intensity is desired.

looks.title: Crystal crop top, oversized denim and double belts
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use an embellished knit or tank with relaxed jeans and one strong belt; suggest a second slim belt only if the waist area stays comfortable and uncluttered.

looks.title: Burgundy bomber, black bra and mini
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Put a burgundy bomber over an opaque black top and black skirt or trousers; use narrow glasses as the only Y2K cue.

looks.title: Golden Disc red corseted gown
looks.alt: Jennie at the Golden Disc Awards in a saturated red corseted gown with long gauzy draped sleeves and a ruby necklace.
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a red dress with a defined seam or waist and a softer sleeve or scarf layer; keep jewelry singular and tonal.

looks.title: Black mini and shearling coat belted outside
silhouette: short base with continuous dark leg
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Belt a soft coat only if it closes comfortably, add opaque tights and a simple black base; choose a medium belt for lower drama.

looks.title: Beige zip knit, bright slim belt and bleached denim
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Wear a beige knit with light straight jeans and one slim colored belt; adjust the rise independently of the color idea.

looks.title: Chocolate suit with derbies and cap
looks.alt: Jennie at the airport in a tonal chocolate houndstooth suit, graphic top, matching cap, dark derbies and structured bag.
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a brown relaxed blazer and trousers with loafers or derbies and a plain cap; a non-matching brown bag still preserves the tonal logic.

looks.title: Met Gala blue embroidered column gown
looks.alt: Jennie at the 2026 Met Gala in a strapless blue column gown covered with sequin leaves, fine jewelry and a sleek updo.
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Choose one blue column dress or coordinated separates with texture concentrated in one area; keep jewelry fine and warm-toned.

looks.title: Chanel Seoul navy top and high-waist trousers
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use an opaque navy square-neck top with high-waist navy trousers and a textured bag; carry or omit the jacket to control formality.

looks.title: Governors Ball New York street collage
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a striped or star-print fitted top with a denim-plaid patchwork skirt of comfortable length, boots, and one city cap; reduce literal flags if preferred.

looks.title: Gold asymmetric stage tunic with belt and boots
silhouette: long moving side and back extension
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Keep the fitted embellished top, micro base, long sheer or printed wrap panel, wide belt and tall boots for a full-intensity version; alter only the pieces the user names.

looks.title: White fitted top, wide black trousers and green bag
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Pair a fitted white long-sleeve top with wide black trousers and flat sandals; add one small colored bag, and choose the trouser rise according to comfort.

looks.title: Black camisole, red mini and low-heel ballet shoes
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a black camisole with a red straight skirt of a comfortable length and black low heels; keep jewelry fine and hair softly controlled.

looks.title: White feathered top, sheer overskirt and brown slouch boots
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use the feathered top, short base, high-opening sheer overskirt and brown suede-like boots directly for beach, nightlife, festival or another desired setting; lining is optional.

looks.title: Cropped military jacket, light inner layer and stacked waist structure
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Preserve the minimal inner layer, cropped military jacket, corset-like waist structure, secondary belt and low-slung trousers when the user wants the full layered architecture; simplify only by request.

looks.title: Reconstructed-denim mini dress with brown tall boots
silhouette: slightly reduced open neckline through visible inner layer
stylingDevices: surface complexity over a simple silhouette
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Choose a structured denim mini or above-knee dress over a fitted white camisole, then add low-heel brown knee boots; lengthen the hem independently of the denim-and-suede idea.

looks.title: Numbered white tank, micro shorts, pale hosiery and red pointed shoes
stylingDevices: black-white base with unexpected color ending
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Keep the fitted white tank, black micro bottom, pale blue or ivory tights and red pointed shoes intact when a graphic full-intensity look is wanted; use the belt and narrow glasses as the final sharp notes.

looks.title: Translucent grey knit, printed scarf and relaxed pale denim
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Layer a translucent fine knit over a dark camisole with relaxed jeans, then add one long printed scarf; the formula works at low or high exposure depending on the inner layer.

looks.title: Asymmetric black volume with leopard mini and patterned tights
stylingDevices: repeated print across garment and hosiery
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a one-shoulder black top with a leopard mini and matching or tonal patterned tights; keep shoes black and pointed so the print remains the only loud signal.

looks.title: Baseball jersey, roomy dark denim and white sneakers
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Wear a navy baseball jersey with roomy dark jeans and clean white sneakers; use a sleek low ponytail or equally precise grooming to keep the relaxed volumes intentional.

looks.title: Red crop and jacket with layered low-slung grey cargos
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Pair a red crop top and roomy red jacket with very wide low-rise grey cargos; preserve the visible layered waist and narrow glasses when the full Jennie intensity is the goal.

looks.title: White fuzzy mini dress under a black racing jacket
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Put an oversized black racing or denim jacket over a white textured mini dress with crew socks and athletic shoes; keep the dress feminine and the outer layer unapologetically sporty.

looks.title: Charcoal micro base with patterned tights and white leg warmers
silhouette: compact dark torso and hip block
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a charcoal micro dress with patterned tights, white leg warmers and pointed shoes; treat hair color or one red accessory as the single narrative interruption.

looks.title: Oversized grey tee with over-knee socks and pointed pumps
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Wear an oversized grey tee over a secure micro short with over-knee black socks or leg warmers and pointed pumps; keep a single long pendant for vertical focus.

looks.title: All-black opaque and openwork evening layers
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Build all black from one opaque oversized top, one openwork hip or skirt layer, sheer tights and pointed heels; preserve the transparency if that is the intended nightlife intensity.

looks.title: Sequin micro dress with lace collar, opera gloves and tall boots
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Wear a sequin mini with a pale lace collar, black lace opera gloves, sheer tights, cat-eye glasses and pointed knee boots; keep one flower accent if the full retro-stage register is desired.

looks.title: Sculptural brown bomber with embroidered micro shorts and slouch boots
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Pair a sculptural cropped brown jacket with embroidered micro shorts, fishnets and roomy brown knee boots; do not shrink the shoulders or lengthen the shorts unless personally requested.

looks.title: Silver satin cowl corset with black mesh and lace-edged micro skirt
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a satin-and-mesh corset with a low asymmetric micro skirt, lace edge, fishnets and pearls for a direct boudoir-stage translation; focus on secure boning and fastening, not automatic coverage.

looks.title: Black leather halter, hardware micro shorts and long gloves
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Combine a leather halter crop, low-rise leather micro shorts, stacked hardware, long gloves and knee boots at full intensity; test movement and closure security without changing the aesthetic premise.

looks.title: All-black beanie, oversized top and tiered long skirt
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Wear a black beanie and roomy black top with a long tiered black skirt, flat shoes and a large tote; let the skirt texture provide all the visual movement.

looks.title: Cropped black denim with gold buckle stack and tall boots
looks.alt: Jennie performing in a cropped black denim jacket and matching micro shorts with oversized gold buckle belts, fishnet tights and black knee boots.
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a cropped black denim jacket, black micro shorts, two oversized gold-buckle belts, fishnets and knee boots directly when maximum waist architecture is wanted.

looks.title: Pale lace mini with furry cuffs, trailing panel and glossy boots
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Wear a sheer pastel lace mini with furry cuffs, a long side panel, fishnets, narrow black glasses and glossy knee boots; keep the trailing movement and hard black grounding for the complete effect.

looks.title: Black corset under slashed white tee with red leather micro shorts
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Layer a cut white graphic tee over a structured black corset with low-rise red leather micro shorts, fishnets, one patterned glove and narrow glasses; keep the asymmetry rather than matching every accessory.

looks.title: Grey ribbed tank, black hood-scarf and relaxed low-rise denim
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Pair a fitted grey tank with truly low-rise relaxed jeans and pointed black shoes, then add a black hood-scarf and narrow glasses; the low rise is a primary element, not a compromise target.

looks.title: White fitted camisole, fuzzy cardigan and very relaxed low-rise jeans
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Wear a fitted white camisole with a visible black bra or bralette, fuzzy grey cardigan, very relaxed low-rise jeans and black belt; keep the pendant long and the rest of the jewelry quiet.

looks.title: Sleeveless black vest with extremely low-slung wide beige trousers
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Use a sleeveless black vest with extremely low-rise floor-length wide trousers, a visible belt, silver chain bag and narrow glasses; hem the trousers precisely while preserving the intended low waist.

looks.title: Grey off-shoulder ruched micro dress with socks and flat Mary Janes
silhouette: close gathered torso and hip line
looks.ordinaryTranslation: Wear a grey off-shoulder ruched micro dress with white socks and tan flat Mary Janes; keep the micro length and exposed shoulder when desired, and use flats to make the mood relaxed rather than formal.
